name: GSplat Skinning Data Loading
definition: A technique to compute the final transformation matrix for a splat by blending up to four bone matrices weighted by skin weights, then applying a reference inverse transform. It supports two storage backends: Texture2D arrays (for GPU compatibility/portability) or StructuredBuffers (for direct access).
summary: GSplat Skinning Data Loading enables skeletal animation of Gaussian splats by blending bone matrices via skin weights, supporting both Texture2D and StructuredBuffer backends.
